newsitem.title: UK: Interview-Backer says WmCook bid full, fair.
newsitem.headline: Interview-Backer says WmCook bid full, fair.

text.p: Venture capitalists Electra Fleming, backing a management buyout bid for steel castings group William Cook Plc, said on Thursday it hoped to convince shareholders it was offering "a full and fair price" at 425p a share, and a better deal than hostile bidder Triplex Lloyd Plc.

Electra Fleming director Tim Syder told Reuters the company had been in touch with William Cook for about three weeks and was "impressed by the team" which has been vigorously defending itself from two bids from Triplex Lloyd over two months.
After initial due diligence, "our conclusion is we find it an attractive investment opportunity", he told Reuters.
